test_cases.setup: POSIX build with mock LoRa radio capturing transmissions; one sensor mock fails POST.
procedure: Boot the FSW.
Capture LoRa transmissions for 30 simulated seconds.
Inspect transmissions for a POST result packet.
Confirm the POST result packet contains a per-sensor pass/fail field with the failing sensor marked failed.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Exactly one POST result packet is transmitted at startup with correct per-sensor pass/fail status.

test_cases.title: Body Axes Convention Inspection
test_cases.setup: Source tree access to body-axis definitions and design docs.
procedure: Inspect design docs and code comments for the body axis convention.
Confirm X is forward, Y is right, Z is down.
Confirm code consuming body-axis quantities is consistent with this convention.
Sign and archive the inspection record.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Inspection record confirms body axes are X-forward, Y-right, Z-down across the FSW.

expected_artifacts.name: body_axes_inspection.md
expected_artifacts.description: Inspection record of body axis convention

test_cases.title: Mark Sensor Unhealthy on Read Failure
test_cases.setup: POSIX build; mock IMU configured to return read errors after t=1 s.
procedure: Run the FSW with healthy IMU for 1 s; capture health bitmap.
Trigger IMU read failures starting at t=1 s.
Capture health bitmap publications after the failure.
Confirm IMU bit transitions to unhealthy after the failure.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Health bitmap shows IMU bit healthy before t=1 s and unhealthy after the read failure occurs.

test_cases.title: Navigation Validity False on Missing Inputs
test_cases.setup: POSIX build with nav app and configurable sensor mocks.
procedure: Run the FSW with all required nav inputs healthy; capture nav state.
Confirm validity flag is true.
Disable a required nav input (e.g., IMU) and continue running.
Confirm validity flag transitions to false in subsequent nav state messages.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Nav validity flag is true with all inputs healthy and false after a required input is disabled.

test_cases.title: Flag SD Card Unhealthy on Write Failure
test_cases.setup: POSIX build; mock SD backend that fails writes during a configurable window.
procedure: Run the FSW with healthy SD for 1 s; capture health bitmap.
Inject SD write failures starting at t=1 s.
Capture health bitmap publications after the failure.
Confirm SD bit transitions to unhealthy.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Health bitmap shows SD bit healthy before t=1 s and unhealthy after the SD write failure.

test_cases.title: Flag Radio Unhealthy on Transmission Failure
test_cases.setup: POSIX build; mock LoRa radio that fails transmissions during a configurable window.
procedure: Run the FSW with healthy radio for 1 s; capture health bitmap.
Inject radio transmission failures starting at t=1 s.
Capture health bitmap publications after the failure.
Confirm radio bit transitions to unhealthy.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Health bitmap shows radio bit healthy before t=1 s and unhealthy after the transmission failure.

test_cases.title: AFM-Loss Tolerance
test_cases.setup: POSIX build; AFM app forced into unavailable state; other apps running.
procedure: Run the FSW for 10 simulated seconds with AFM disabled or stalled.
Capture nav state, telemetry, and SD log records.
Confirm nav state is published at 100 Hz throughout.
Confirm telemetry transmits at 2 Hz throughout.
Confirm logger continues writing IMU/baro/GPS records at their static rates.
test_cases.acceptance_criteria: Nav, telemetry, and logging continue at their static rates while AFM is unavailable.
